item.title: Army veteran detained in Ventura County immigration raid sues federal government
item.description: A U.S. citizen and Army veteran who was taken into immigration custody during a major raid in Camarillo last summer is challenging the federal government in a lawsuit.

item.title: Oscars Pick'em: Can you predict the winners of the 2026 Oscars?
item.description: Think you know who will win big at the 98th Academy Awards? Then it's time to play Oscars Pick'em!

item.title: Man charged with murder after partial remains of missing Hemet teen found
item.description: A man has been charged in the murder of a 17-year-old Hemet girl whose partial remains were found in a field two months ago.

item.title: 6 mothers identified as victims of deadly avalanche near Lake Tahoe
item.description: Six women killed in an avalanche near Lake Tahoe were all mothers and experienced skiers who were on a trip together, their families said in a statement released on Thursday.

item.title: Trump says he doesn't know if aliens are real but directs government to release files on UFOs, more
item.description: President Donald Trump said Thursday that he's directing the Pentagon and other government agencies to identify and release files related to extraterrestrials and UFOs because of "tremendous interest."

item.title: SoCal gets brief break from rain with slight weekend warm-up
item.description: After back-to-back storms, Southern California is getting a break from the wet weather, bringing a partly cloudy, cool day on Friday.

item.title: LA County accuses Roblox of exposing children to online predators in new lawsuit
item.description: Los Angeles County has filed a lawsuit against Roblox, alleging the massively popular online gaming platform fails to adequately protect children from online predators.

item.title: Thieves carve hole through drywall to steal high-value Pokémon cards from Anaheim shop
item.description: Video shows the burglars smashing glass display cases, grabbing hundreds of trading cards in less than 10 minutes.

item.title: Culver City mall evacuated after fire reported at Target store
item.description: The Westfield Culver City mall was evacuated Thursday night after a fire was reported at the Target store, authorities said.

item.title: LA leaders want to crack down on human trafficking along Figueroa Corridor. What's their plan?
item.description: L.A. officials are stepping up efforts to curb rampant sex and human trafficking along the Figueroa Corridor as major global events approach.
